title: Moradia T5 c/ piscina | Cascais
description:
Moradia isolada T5 de arquitetura contemporânea com zona lounge com deck em ruivina, jardim relvado, piscina e ótima exposição solar, inserida num condomínio em Cascais.

Principais Áreas:

Piso 0

. Hall de entrada 10m2

. Sala de estar e jantar 70m2 com acesso direto à zona lounge

. Cozinha 25m2 totalmente equipada com ilha em open space

. Quarto 15m2 com built-in closet

. WC social 5m2

Piso 1 

. Master Suite 32m2 com walk-in closet, wc e varanda

. Suite 30m2 com built-in closet, wc e varanda

. Suite 25m2 com built-in closet, wc e varanda

Piso -1

. Lavandaria e garagem em open space com 146 m² + garrafeira

Equipada com ar condicionado por conduta, chão e teto radiante, corian em todos os wc´s, estores electricos, bomba de calor, aspiração central, lareira, vidros duplos com caixilharia Sapa, elevador, barbecue e churrasqueira a gás, painéis fotovoltaicos, domótica e conduta para a roupa com vácuo direto à lavandaria.

Em zona nobre de Cascais, a poucos minutos da praia e dos melhores campos de golfe de Portugal. Próxmo de esplanadas, bares, restaurantes distinguidos com estrelas Michelin, centro hípico, health clubs e SPA. A propriedade encontra-se a 8 minutos do Centro hípico da Quinta da Marinha, a 10 minutos da Praia do Guincho, 15 minutos do Oitavos Dunes Golf Club e a 15 minutos da Marina de Cascais. Com excelentes acessos às principais auto-estradas ficando apenas a 30 minutos do Aeroporto de Lisboa.

Detached 5 bedroom Villa featuring contemporary architecture, a lounge area with a wooden deck, a lawned garden, a swimming pool, and excellent sunlight exposure, located within a gated community in Cascais.

Main Areas:

Ground Floor

. Entry hall 10m²

. Living and dining room 70m² with direct access to the lounge area

. Fully equipped kitchen 25m² with an open-concept island

. Bedroom 15m² with built-in closet

. Guest bathroom 5m²

1st Floor 

. Master Suite 32m² with walk-in closet, bathroom, and balcony

. Suite 30m² with built-in closet, bathroom, and balcony

. Suite 25m² with built-in closet, bathroom, and balcony

Basement

. Laundry room and garage in an open-plan space of 146 m² + wine cellar

Equipped with ducted air conditioning, radiant floor and ceiling heating, Corian countertops in all bathrooms, electric blinds, heat pump, central vacuum system, fireplace, double-pane windows with Sapa frames, elevator, barbecue and gas grill, solar panels, home automation, and a vacuum-assisted laundry chute leading directly to the laundry room.

Located in a prime area of Cascais, just minutes from the beach and Portugal's finest golf courses. Close to outdoor cafés, bars, Michelin-starred restaurants, an equestrian center, health clubs, and a spa. The property is located 8 minutes from the Quinta da Marinha Equestrian Center, 10 minutes from Guincho Beach, 15 minutes from the Oitavos Dunes Golf Club, and 15 minutes from the Cascais Marina. It offers excellent access to major highways and is just 30 minutes from Lisbon Airport.
